b: I'm old (36) and have never been much of a social media guy. I moved to LA recently and I'm finding whenever I hang out with the younger gen, they want to exchange instagram instead of a phone number. A few questions for you youngens:
Is it more normal to swap insta than phone these days, or is it more of a cop out?
If I do create a Insta profile, is it weird that it's going to be like brand new with nothing on it?
Posting a bunch of pics of myself feels narcissistic. Do I just need to get over it or is it normal to not have many pics of yourself?
Stuff that's cringe that I should avoid?
Any other advice on this? Thanks in advance guys!
